name: La Almunia de Doña Godina (Spain)
description: White field with a red cross throughout, charged at the crossing with the crowned arms of La Almunia de Doña Godina (a castle on blue).
history: Municipal flag of La Almunia de Doña Godina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Almunia de Doña Godina arms — castle on blue
castle and crown of the arms
